concerns.text: FR-009 (Makefile orchestration with targets `all`, `evaluate`, `enrich`, `summary`, `clean` and wall‑clock ≤ 6 h) is not assigned to any phase in the Phase Mapping table.
FR-010 (JSON‑Line logging of all major actions, warnings, errors) is absent from the Phase Mapping; the plan mentions a generic “Constitution Check” but does not tie FR‑010 to a specific phase.
FR-012 (CLI flag `--seed <int>` for global reproducibility) is missing from the phase‑wise mapping.
FR-013 (validation of `predicted_ppi_<species>.tsv` against `predicted_edges.schema.yaml`) is not listed in any phase.

FR-017 (post‑target verification of output file presence and parsability) is not assigned to any phase; the plan only mentions a generic “Verification” step in Phase 6 without explicitly mapping FR‑017.

SC-002 (at least one GO term with adjusted p‑value < 0.05 per species) is not explicitly referenced in the Phase Mapping or in any user‑story acceptance criteria, despite being a mandatory success criterion.
